exposure: Ablative necrosis within the uterine cavity
Dense fibrosis and hyalinization of the endometrial surface
Ablation changes only in the lower uterine segment
cohort: 164 hysterectomy specimens from patients who previously underwent endometrial ablation, including 19 control cases.
finding: Specific clinicopathologic features, including ablative necrosis and superficial abnormal blood vessels, are associated with a shorter interval to hysterectomy after endometrial ablation, while adenomyosis and prior tubal ligation are linked to continued bleeding.
